access/kubernetes/rbacRuleAllows#a rule.note: Refuted with a rule whose ResourceNames lists "": the original RuleAllows (v1.37.1) allows `create pods` (no name) by ResourceNames [""] and denies it by ["web"]. The whitelist matches the empty name like any other; the docs' claim (resourceNames cannot restrict create) is about rules that name real resources. Restated as "a rule naming only non-empty resources never allows an unnamed request".
The restatement of "a rule naming resources never allows an unnamed request" (refuted by ResourceNames [""], confirmed on the original); proven.
